title: Week 33 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “tariff”?
options: Organization of resources under uncertainty to create or improve products and processes.
A market dominated by a small number of interdependent firms.
A tax imposed on imported goods or services.
A significant, broad decline in economic activity lasting more than a brief fluctuation.
questions.explanation: Tariff means a tax imposed on imported goods or services.
choices: Organization of resources under uncertainty to create or improve products and processes.
A market dominated by a small number of interdependent firms.
A tax imposed on imported goods or services.
A significant, broad decline in economic activity lasting more than a brief fluctuation.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “quota”?
options: A legislature’s grant of authority to an executive agency or official.
A cost that changes with output.
A quantitative limit on imports or exports.
A legally recognized authority to use, exclude, transfer, or benefit from an asset subject to law.
questions.explanation: Quota means a quantitative limit on imports or exports.
choices: A legislature’s grant of authority to an executive agency or official.
A cost that changes with output.
A quantitative limit on imports or exports.
A legally recognized authority to use, exclude, transfer, or benefit from an asset subject to law.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “exchange rate”?
options: The official process of compiling, reviewing, and certifying election returns.
Legislation authorizing government spending for specified purposes.
The price of one currency in terms of another.
The difference between the market price and the minimum a producer would accept.
questions.explanation: Exchange rate means the price of one currency in terms of another.
choices: The official process of compiling, reviewing, and certifying election returns.
Legislation authorizing government spending for specified purposes.
The price of one currency in terms of another.
The difference between the market price and the minimum a producer would accept.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “appreciation”?
options: An increase in a currency’s value relative to another currency.
A market with many firms selling differentiated products and relatively easy entry.
Workers’ willingness and ability to offer labor at different compensation levels.
The channels through which monetary policy affects financial conditions, spending, employment, and prices.
questions.explanation: Appreciation means an increase in a currency’s value relative to another currency.
choices: An increase in a currency’s value relative to another currency.
A market with many firms selling differentiated products and relatively easy entry.
Workers’ willingness and ability to offer labor at different compensation levels.
The channels through which monetary policy affects financial conditions, spending, employment, and prices.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “trade balance”?
options: The value of the best alternative forgone when a choice is made.
The value of exports minus imports of goods and services.
A tax whose effective rate rises as the tax base or ability to pay rises.
Rapid withdrawals driven by fear that an institution cannot meet obligations.
questions.explanation: Trade balance means the value of exports minus imports of goods and services.
choices: The value of the best alternative forgone when a choice is made.
The value of exports minus imports of goods and services.
A tax whose effective rate rises as the tax base or ability to pay rises.
Rapid withdrawals driven by fear that an institution cannot meet obligations.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “capital flow”?
options: The rate charged on eligible borrowing from Federal Reserve lending facilities.
A reward, penalty, rule, or condition that changes the costs or benefits of an action.
Powers exercised by both national and state governments.
Cross-border investment, lending, borrowing, or asset purchase.
questions.explanation: Capital flow means cross-border investment, lending, borrowing, or asset purchase.
choices: The rate charged on eligible borrowing from Federal Reserve lending facilities.
A reward, penalty, rule, or condition that changes the costs or benefits of an action.
Powers exercised by both national and state governments.
Cross-border investment, lending, borrowing, or asset purchase.
